notes.title: Outfits and Ollie Changes
notes.notes:
Millie
- New outfit: Summer Run (Pants and Bikini versions)
Ollie
- New outfit: Metal Ollie. Bonus: this skin lets Ollie breathe water.
- New outfit: Leopard. Donny's back! In Ollie form!
- Fixed Super Ollie's missing sparkles with his basic outfit.
- Ollie can now roll when landing. Press [attack] in the air and hold while landing to roll.
- Ollie can now Stop Drop (but not roll). Do a [down+air] attack to drop straight down.
- Ollie's wall grind animation now only plays if he's not in ball form.
Enemies
- Crows now show up over the foreground.
- Crawler Golems now stay activated for a short time.
Levels
- Added some invisible collision to Sparkleshine Caves to make some walls easier to wall jump on.

notes.title: New Outfits and Other Changes
notes.notes:
Millie
- New outfit: Gunslinger.
- New outfit and weapon set: Shade Armor and Shade Blades, based on a design by @shaden1ne.	[url=https://freakyjohnny.newgrounds.com/]https://freakyjohnny.newgrounds.com/[/url]
Ollie
- Ollie's buffered jump now correctly does a spin jump instead of a normal one.
- Ollie now jumps a little higher.
- Revised Super Ollie music.
- Adjusted the speeds at which Ollie's different run animations play.
- Ollie's special now drains at a rate of 1.5 mana per second, down from 2.
Levels
- Taking the upper exit of a room now leads to the upper entrance of the next room, not the lower one.
- Entering a room after a checkpoint uses the exit taken before the checkpoint so you're still on the same path.
- The map widget now shows your overall progress through the current stage.
- Revised the layout of some rooms.
Fixes
- Kickbridges are now slightly wider so you don't land on the ground when sliding down the right side of it.
- The camera now tracks the target using a static height. Before, it would change with the character's hit box.

notes.title: Obligatory Next-Day Patch
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
-The Buzzqueen's 50% HP routine can now interrupt her energy ball phase.
-The Buzzqueen no longer swoops away as far and it no longer fails if the player is far away when it starts.
-Added sound effects to the Buzzqueen's big energy balls.
-Characters now properly bounce back up if they run off the bottom of the level.
-Heather can no longer spam attacks by animation cancelling.
-Changed some springs to override player velocity so the result is a lot less stupid.
-Reduced the area in which you can trigger Kickbridges so it makes more sense.

notes.title: Petal Pass Patch
notes.notes:
[h2]New Stage: Petal Pass[/h2]
It's back from Millie 7! Sort of!

[h2]Other Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Attacks no longer cause recoil if they kill the enemy. For example, Millie will keep going if she charges into an enemy and kills it.
[*]Max Health Hearts dropped by bosses now magnetize immediately.
[*]Fixed issue with fixed background placement.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- The updraft animation no longer plays if you're dead.
- Heart pickups no longer affect you if you're dead.
- Cannon Moles and Bomber Moles now wait until the player is closer before they attack.
- Turned down the volume on the Grand Burrows music.
- The boss health display now correctly shows Mole King's name when fighting him.

notes.title: Holly Patch
notes.notes:
[b]New Character: Holly[/b]
Holly is a dumb bunny who cosplays as a knight with armor she found and throws a sword she found.

[b]Shimmerpetal Forest[/b]
Removed breakable walls from Heavy Mole's boos room.
Floaty Moles now have smaller hitboxes.
Most waterfalls in are in the background now.

[b]Other[/b]
Characters now play their boss intro animation even if they enter the area midair.

notes.title: Bug FIxes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

notes.title: Shimmerpetal Forest Patch
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

[b]New Stage: Shimmerpetal Forest[/b]
Shimmerpetal Forest is here! Millie's village is under attack so hurry through the forest to save the day.

Shimmerpetal Forest has been added to the stage sequence in both Adventure mode and Free Play mode.

[b]Characters[/b]
[list]
[*]Mal can breathe water now.
[*]Heather's black holes are now breakers.
[*]Anne, Hattie, Heather, and Millie now have a greater variety of panties in their daily rotations.
[*]All characters now have a special animation that plays during boss intros.
[*]Millie and Yrra now dash if they're running at dash speed.
[*]Millie's down+air now deals 16 damage, up from 8.
[*]Yrra no longer has to deplete her flying time before she slowfalls. Hold the jump button.
[*]Yrra's jump stab hits sooner.
[*]Corrected hitbox of Monda's slam waves.
[/list]

[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*]Added functionality for solid enemies.
[*]Added functionality for enemies to require breaker attacks.
[*]Player projectiles can now be destroyed by enemies (namely, the Skeleton Knight Thing).
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*]Corrected placement of some platforms.
[/list]

notes.title: Heather Patch
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

[b]New playable character: Heather[/b]
[list]

[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed rotation issues with Mal's charge orbs.
[*]Fixed some animation issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Mal Patch
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
[list]
[*] New playable character: Mal. Mal is an undead archer cyclops with multiple charge levels.
[*] Another new character, Heather, has been added to the game but isn't playable yet.
[*] Gem Head's jumps are now more consistent.
[*] Attacks now cancel the fall pit mercy timer.
[*] Bat Pudgie's Master difficulty revenge attack is now a skull to make it less confusing.
[*] Charging attacks now supports multiple levels. Mal is the only character with multiple charge levels.
[*] Monda's air+down can no longer be spammed.
[*] Enemy invincibility frames now only protect against the source of the attack, not all attacks. This means that multiple projectiles can all hit an enemy at the same time, like Hattie's chaos globs.
[/list]

Please report any bugs. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Next Patch: Mal and Heather
notes.notes:
The next patch for Millie Megavolte 8 will include two new characters: Mal and Heather.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934259/12773698760c5da5c7f66b671dbc991aaa476eb1.png[/img]
Left to right: Mal, Heather, Hiroshi, Millie

Mal is an undead cyclops who shoots magic arrows with his bow. He's unique so far in that he has multiple charge levels. Charging longer adds more arrows and power to the attack. Mal also has an evasive directional triple jump that passes through enemies.

In Mal's story (coming eventually, work with me here), he rises from his grave and seeks revenge on those that put him there. The only problem is that he's been dead for hundreds of years.

Heather is a nellish polarity mage. Her secondary ability is to switch her polarity which changes her spells. While her special is active, she uses both polarities at once!

In Heather's story, all nellish journey outside their isolated village of Nell to see the world when they come of age. However, third-hand accounts and even being 120 years old can't prepare one for what's outside the sanctuary.

Look forward to it!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[u]New Stuff[/u]
- Rumble is now implemented through Steam Input. Right now it will only rumble when you take damage. Rumble can be disabled in the Options Menu.
[u]Changes[/u]
- Hiroshi's neutral charged ground now sends out airrows instead of doing damage directly.
- Hiroshi's rocks now spawn higher so they're less likely to spawn in the ground and immediately break.
- The Options Menu is now accessible from the Pause Menu.
[u]Fixes[/u]
- Boss health and other things are properly reset now when you exit the current run.
- The option "Show Gelder On HUD" now applies to the stopwatch too.

notes.title: Hiroshi Update
notes.notes:
[u]New Stuff[/u]
- Hiroshi is now playable.
- Added an air supply meter when underwater. The meter won't show for characters that can breathe underwater (like Pearl).

[u]Changes[/u]
- Pearl now shoots "low" while crouching.

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
- Jump queuing now resets properly.
- Switching characters now forces a hit box update.
